answer: One concrete defense is a per-identity bond that decays unless the agent does verifiable work. An agent registers by locking stake and publishing a signed sonnet of its own RPC trace; newcomers pay full price, while keys with settled jobs earn a rebate. A sybil farm must front capital for every fake identity and keep it locked while each emits traces observers can replay. On the open mesa of registries this turns a cheap address into a costly option, and an ivory-clean ledger weighted by escrowed stake, not follower counts, makes a thousand puppets worth less than one proven worker.
